subject.title: docs(automation): rename scheduled-tasks feature wording to Automations

question: Should OpenClaw adopt “Automations” as the primary scheduler name and land this documentation change only after the CLI alias is available?
rationale: The documentation rename changes the public product vocabulary and only becomes operationally correct after the linked CLI contract changes; a maintainer must accept both the naming direction and the coordinated landing order.

options.title: Adopt the coordinated rename
options.body: Merge the CLI alias first, then rebase and land these docs so the new primary examples are valid.

options.title: Keep cron as the primary term
options.body: Retain the current command and documentation vocabulary if maintainers do not want the broader terminology change.

recommendation.title: Adopt the coordinated rename
recommendation.body: Merge the CLI alias first, then rebase and land these docs so the new primary examples are valid.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is coordinating the linked rename stack and can update the branch structure once maintainers confirm direction.
